snippet.title: Therapig - Mental Health Game Jam 2022
snippet.description:
Our entry as Invisible Studios for the Mental Health Game Jam.

You can play it on: https://sergiomartinez.itch.io/therapig

Synopsis
The game stars Dr. Porkez who, after some bad personal experiences, opens a practice in the little city of Dawntown to help with the mental issues of the citizens.


We will listen our patients, get to know them and try to help them with their different problems.

Your job will be to help others while helping yourself.

Controls
You can play the game with mouse or touching the screen!

Dani Gómez as Pixel Artist / Sound designer
Montse M. Sillero as Concept / Pixel Artist
Daniel Ureña as Game Designer / Narrative
Sergio Martínez as Programmer

Trailer Music Credits:
Ethereal by Ghostrifter Official | https://soundcloud.com/ghostrifter-official
